newsitem.title: UK: P&O up for second day after Nedlloyd deal.
newsitem.headline: P&O up for second day after Nedlloyd deal.

text.p: Shares in P&O rose sharply for a second day on Tuesday as the hotels-to-construction group's container merger with Nedlloyd of the Netherlands raised hopes for further restructuring moves, traders said.
The stock was up 19-1/2p at 580 by 0911 GMT, extending Monday's 43-1/2p surge, after initially rising as high as 586p -- its highest since July 1995.
"The stock is building from yesterday's container deal and there is talk of a Channel ferry deal to come," said one trader.
"There is still a chance that the Nedlloyd deal might get blocked but the market is saying that is not very likely."
